seo.homeInstallIOS: Vula freetvgarden.com kwiSafari. Cofa i icon yokwabelana, emva koko "Yongeza kwiSkrini saseKhaya." Oku kongeza i-icon ye-app kwi-iPhone okanye kwi-iPad yakho esungula indawo egcwele isikrini-akukho luhlu lweVenkile ye-App efunekayo, kwaye akukho nto yokugcina ihlaziywa.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV: Vula i-browser eyakhelwe-ngaphakathi ye-TV yakho kwaye uhambe uye ku- freetvgarden.com . Ukuba iTV yakho ayinaso isikhangeli esisebenzisekayo, phosa iphepha kwifowuni yakho okanye ilaptop usebenzisa iChromecast okanye iAirPlay ukubukela kwiscreen esikhulu endaweni yoko.
seo.homeInstallFire: Vula isikhangeli seSilk (esifakwe ngaphambili kwizixhobo zeTV zoMlilo, okanye simahla kwiAmazon Appstore) kwaye uye ku freetvgarden.com . Khetha ilizwe okanye udidi kwaye uqalise ukubukela — akukho mrhumo okanye usetyenziso olongezelelweyo olufunekayo.
seo.homeInstallDesktop: Nasiphi na isikhangeli sedesktop sangoku siyasebenza — vele undwendwele freetvgarden.com . Kwi-Chrome okanye kwi-Edge, i-icon yokufaka ibonakala kwibar yedilesi ukuyongeza njenge-desktop app; ngenye indlela ihamba kakuhle njengesikhangeli sesithuba esiqhelekileyo.
